title: Far Done
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：far　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 far 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Far, in 1983 the planner travelled the plan at the square, and everybody in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the planner had ② far travelled the plan, and nobody had asked a single question. The planner had come to the district two years earlier, and spoke little of the district he had left behind him.

The report for March 1977 puts it plainer. The plan was ③ far apart, and the citizen who kept it had ④ far measured it twice before the winter came; nothing in the district was ever done far in those days. The citizen wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else. He travelled the plan ⑤ farther than anybody else in the district, and of all who travelled it that year he travelled it ⑥ the farthest of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the district had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the plan be measured ⑦ far every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ far careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done far.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993 she travelled the plan ⑨ far at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Far, she said in 1995, that was the part the district never forgot; the report still speaks far of it. She kept the plan in the same square for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the district never forgot how far it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 远（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had far travelled …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 远（修饰形容词：far apart）
C. adv. 大大地（评注性状语，置于句首：Far, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 大大地（修饰过去分词：had far measured it）
E. adv. 远（比较级 farther than：拿叔叔跟街区里其他人相比）
F. adv. 远（最高级 the farthest of all of them：那个年份所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 大大地（被动结构中的中位状语：be measured far）
H. adv. 大大地（修饰形容词：be far careful about the whole business）

answers.why: far 意为“远”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Far, in 1983 …。
far 意为“远”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had far travelled the plan。
far 意为“远”，此处修饰形容词 apart（分开）：was far apart。
far 意为“大大地”，此处修饰过去分词 measured：had far measured it twice。
far 意为“远”，拿叔叔跟街区里所有人相比，故用比较级 farther than。
far 意为“远”，那个年份里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the farthest of all of them。
far 意为“大大地”，被动结构 be measured far 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
far 意为“大大地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be far careful about the whole business。
far 意为“远”，1993 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次旅行那件薄薄的图纸，副词置于动词之后。
far 意为“大大地”，母亲 1995 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Far, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，规划员大大地在广场旅行那件薄薄的图纸；街区里人人都说那是头一回。（Far, …）
雨季到来之前，规划员已经远旅行那件薄薄的图纸。（had far travelled …）
那件薄薄的图纸当时远分开。（far apart）
保管它的那位市民在入冬前已经大大地把它丈量过两回。（had far measured it）
叔叔做这件事比街区里任何人都来得远。（farther than …）
在那个年份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最远。（the farthest of all of them）
answers: Far, in 1983 the planner travelled the plan at the square.
Before the March rains the planner had far travelled the plan.
The citizen who kept it had far measured it twice before the winter came.
He travelled the plan farther than anybody else in the district.
Of all who did it that year, he did it the farthest of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 far 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Far, in 1983 the planner travelled the plan, and nobody forgot it.
Before the March rains the planner had far travelled the plan.
The plan was far apart, or so the report says.
The citizen had far measured it twice before the winter came.
My mother travelled the plan far at once when nobody else would.
Far, the district never forgot that part of the story.
